parameters.jsCode: const x=$input.first().json;const c=x.context;const attempts=c?.budget?.max_attempts;if(!Number.isSafeInteger(attempts)||attempts<1||attempts>5)throw new Error('invalid storage attempt budget');const storage_retry_allowed=attempts>1;const reserve=storage_retry_allowed?11000:5000;if(c&&Date.now()+reserve>c.deadline_at)throw new Error('storage budget exhausted; checkpoint unchanged');if(!c||!['gmail','calendar'].includes(c.source)||c.account_email!==c.profile_account_email||!x.record||typeof x.record.id!=='string'||!x.record.id||!(c.cursor===null||typeof c.cursor==='string'))throw new Error('invalid approved provider envelope');const serialize=(context,record)=>JSON.stringify({source:context.source,account_email:context.account_email,profile_account_email:context.profile_account_email,...(context.calendar_id?{calendar_id:context.calendar_id}:{}),records:[record],previous_cursor:context.cursor,cursor:context.cursor,complete:false,reconcile:false,window_start:context.window_start,window_end:context.window_end,seen_record_ids:[record.id]});if(typeof x.storage_body!=='string'||Buffer.byteLength(x.storage_body,'utf8')>c.budget.max_body_bytes||x.storage_body!==serialize(c,x.record))throw new Error('invalid approved storage body');return [{json:{...x,storage_retry_allowed}}];

## TendGoogle13
**Purpose:** Sub-workflow: normalize and store approved Google records.

**Inputs:** Called by 11 and 12 with raw approved records.

**Outputs:** Committed records in the canonical store and page context.

**Privacy:** Validates the approved scope before any write. Private lane: no execution data is saved (success and error), so provider text never lands in n8n history.
